scientific_interpretation: Representation-induced response-law transmutation persists across unimodal, non-antipodal bimodal, asymmetric and sparse fields. Exact antipodal symmetry suppresses representation-separated polar channels, but does not erase representation dependence in activity, even harmonics or the full action distribution.

terminology.encoding_phrase: different encodings of the same underlying field family

not_claimed: full operator collapse under antipodal symmetry
